label: batch-35
tail:
Batch 35 authoring is complete: **17 items** across the A/B pages, with proof contracts, coverage evidence, and dependency records. The plan and design agree; no conflict was recorded.

- **15 items are ready; 2 are escalated:** `thm-s4-convolution-filter-complexity` and `ex-s4-filter-cost-excludes-training`. The exact-arithmetic filter bound is proved. The source-reported finite-precision cost still needs a supplier establishing the accuracy norm, arithmetic model, root-separation and Woodbury-conditioning bounds, and propagated error proof. The escalation is recorded against `thm-cauchy-root-grid-matvec-numerical-cost`; the [S4 paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.00396) and [Pan’s treatment](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02285) do not establish those missing details.
- **Scoped checks passed:** proof layout (17 items, 38 steps), precheck (10/10), render and focused dependency checks, proof contracts (17/17), coverage (25 harvested results), manifest dependencies, and source-fetch verification (4/4).
- **Run-wide work remains open outside this batch:** the latest Step 1 check reports 328 items, 82 ready; Autopilot remains at `1-scaffold`, 11/101 covered, with an owner-repair/recertification blocker. The run-wide empty-inventory and stale-scheduling issues are recorded in the notes and were left to their owners.

Evidence is in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-35.notes.md>), [page manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-35.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-35.proof-contracts.json>), and [coverage record](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-35.coverage.json>).
